cross_verification.note_en: Mauritius Passport and Immigration Office's official 'Visa Requirements' page (passport.govmu.org/passport/?page_id=605) and 'Application for Visa' page (page_id=620) were fetched directly. They confirm 'two recent passport-size photos' are required for a visa application but do not themselves publish size/background/composition specifications separate from the passport standard. Since neither page states that the passport-specific standard (see mu-passport.json: 35-40mm x 45-50mm, light background, 25-35mm face length, 6 months) applies identically to visa photos, those figures were not carried over here to avoid asserting an unconfirmed cross-document equivalence.
